item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00472","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C04","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both directives create a presidential commission of designated members, assign it an investigative study followed by a report and legislative or administrative recommendations, authorize public hearings and witnesses, direct executive-agency cooperation and information assistance, fund the body through a presidential allotment subject to nearly identical statutory exceptions, and terminate it thirty days after its report. The close language and parallel operative sequence are substantially more specific than generic commission boilerplate. C04 and C20 share portions of this machinery, but neither matches the child's full sequence as closely as C09.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby established in the Executive Office of the President a commission to be known as the President's Commission on Internal Security and Individual Rights, which shall be composed of a Chairman, a Vice Chairman, and seven other members, all of whom shall be designated by the President.","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby created a Commission to be known as the President's Commission on Migratory Labor, which shall consist of a Chairman and four other members to be designated by the President.","explanation":"Both open by creating a named President's commission composed of a chairman and additional presidential designees."},{"child_excerpt":"The Commission shall make a report to the President of its findings and conclusions ... and shall make such recommendations for legislative, administrative, or other action as it deems appropriate.","parent_excerpt":"The Commission shall make a report of its studies to the President in writing ... including its recommendations for Governmental action, either legislative or administrative.","explanation":"The reporting mandate and the formulation of recommendations for legislative or administrative action closely correspond."},{"child_excerpt":"The Commission may hold such public hearings and hear such witnesses as it may determine ... All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require","parent_excerpt":"the Commission is authorized to hold such public hearings and to hear such witnesses as it deems appropriate. ... All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require","explanation":"This is distinctive, nearly verbatim shared language combining hearing authority with mandatory interagency cooperation and assistance."},{"child_excerpt":"The expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation \"Executive Office of the President-Emergencies (National defense)\". Such payments shall be made without regard to ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909 ... and ... such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.","parent_excerpt":"the expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation ... \"Emergency Fund for the President\" ... Such payments shall be made without regard to the provisions of section 3681 ... section 9 of the Act of March 4, 1909 ... and such other provisions of law as the President may hereafter specify.","explanation":"Both use the same presidential-allotment funding mechanism and essentially the same trio of statutory exceptions."},{"child_excerpt":"Thirty days after the presentation of its final report to the President, the Commission shall cease to exist unless the President shall otherwise direct.","parent_excerpt":"Thirty days after rendition of its report to the President, the Commission shall cease to exist unless otherwise determined by further Executive Order.","explanation":"The termination clauses use the same unusual trigger: dissolution thirty days after submission of the commission's report, subject to presidential extension."}]}
